The '''Written Charon language''' was the written form of the [[Charon (language)|language]] of the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was composed of intricate web-shaped characters that had the appearance of a decorative pattern.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
